Pyronaridine Phosphate (rINNM) Fosfato de pironaridina; Malaridine Phosphate; Pyronaridine, Phosphate de; Pyronaridini Phosphas. 7-Chloro-2-methoxy-10- [3,5-bis(pyrrolidinomethyl)-4-hydroxyanilino]benzo-[b]-1,5- naphthyridine phosphate. Пиронаридина Фосфат C29H32ClN5O2,4H3PO4 = 910.0. CAS — 74847-35-1 (pyronaridine); 76748-86-2 (pyronar- idine phosphate). (pyronaridine) Pharmacopoeias. In Chin. Profile Pyronaridine is a naphthyridine derivative used in China in the treatment of vivax malaria and chloroquine-resistant falciparum malaria. Its use has also been investigated in Africa and in Thai- land. Combination of pyronaridine with artesunate is also being investigated. Pyronaridine has been given as the phosphate by mouth or by intramuscular or intravenous injection. ◊ References. 1. Shao B-R. A review of antimalarial drug pyronaridine.
